dialect.detail: Applewood Computers Accounting System (ACAS), compiled with GnuCOBOL/OpenCOBOL; uses >>source free directive, *> comments, and GNU GPL licensing. Version 3.02.06.
evidence: 22/03/09 vbc - 3.0.00 Migration to Open Cobol v3.00.00

purpose.domain_detail: Accounts payable cheque/payment file writer for the Applewood Computers Accounting System (ACAS); produces a CSV-style text file for cheque printing via mail-merge or BACS bank payment submission
purpose.summary: This program is the cheque file writer module (pl940) of the ACAS purchase ledger subsystem. It reads supplier payment records and writes a formatted output file (645-byte records) containing payee details, amounts in words and figures, invoice references, and dates, suitable for mail-merge printing or bank payment (BACS) submission. It also updates payment records with the payment date.

notable_features: COPY statements for modular copybooks (wspl.cob, plwspay.cob, wsmaps03.cob, wsnames.cob, etc.)
Number-to-words table (word-filler) for cheque amount in words (1-99)
REDEFINES on word-filler for indexed access
Currency name parameterisation via WS-Currency-Major / WS-Currency-Minor
OCCURS clause for address lines and invoice detail lines
Dummy 01-level for unused file handler call parameters
verdict.notes: Source truncated at 16000 chars; procedure division not visible but mechanical indicators show 19 PERFORMs, 11 GOTOs, 2 CALLs, and 11 COPYs, consistent with a production batch program. No COMP-3 usage despite financial domain — amounts stored as PICTURE Z/9 display items. Originally written 1984, last updated 2024.
